topology.d6hClosureRule: the tied axial orbit [13, 31] is invariant as a set under the fixture's D6h rotations, mirrors, and z reflection; both members attach atomically at event ordinal 4

formulas.environmentEquations: temperatureK = tempC + celsiusZeroK; saturationPressurePa = saturationPressurePrefactorMbar * exp(saturationPressureExponentK / temperatureK) * mbarToPa with signed saturationPressureExponentK = -6150 and no second unary minus; cSat = saturationPressurePa / (kBoltzmannJPerK * temperatureK); diffusivity = diffusivityAir1AtmM2S * standardAtmospherePa / pressurePa; thermalSpeed = sqrt(kBoltzmannJPerK * temperatureK / (2 * PI * waterMoleculeMassKg)); vKinMS = cSat / iceNumberDensityPerM3 * thermalSpeed; x0M = cSat / iceNumberDensityPerM3 * diffusivity / vKinMS; dxM = dxUm * 1e-6; q = dxM / x0M
formulas.inPlaneEquation: for each active cell, pair opposite values (east + west), (northEast + southWest), (southEast + northWest), sort the three pair sums ascending, then uInPlane = (((own + lowPair) + middlePair) + highPair) / 7; blocked or out-of-domain neighbors reflect own
formulas.verticalEquation: uCandidate = (4 / 7) * uInPlane + (3 / 14) * (upInPlane + downInPlane), with blocked or out-of-domain vertical neighbors reflecting uInPlane
formulas.opposingEquation: sigmaOpp is the arithmetic mean of the immutable post-smoother candidate values opposite every attached neighbor, summed in ascending numeric value order under aggregate-hv-g1h1-v6
formulas.boundaryEquation: alphaHKBoundary = basalPrefactor * exp(-basalSigma0 / sigmaBoundary) for positive basal sigmaBoundary, inhibited cells use zero, rough cells use one; sigmaBoundary = sigmaOpp / (1 + alphaHKBoundary * robinGeometry * q)
formulas.preEventScalarEquation: let I = sigmaInfinity, s = the tied axial boundary value, uAxial = (s + 6 * I) / 7, uCap = I, and o = (4 / 7) * I + (3 / 14) * (uAxial + I) = (95 * I + 3 * s) / 98; substituting Eq. 5.34 gives F(s) = s * (1 + (98 / 95) * q * exp(-0.007 / s)) - I = 0

bisection.stopRule: stop when the binary64 midpoint equals either current endpoint or after 256 bracket updates
bisection.selectionRule: select the endpoint with smaller absolute F; on equality select the lower endpoint

eventUpdate.timeStepEquation: deltaTimeSeconds = cflFill / maxPositiveFillRate and cumulative time is the left-to-right binary64 sum of cycle deltas
eventUpdate.fillEquation: rawIncrement = fillRatePerSecond * deltaTimeSeconds; demand adds rawIncrement; placed adds min(rawIncrement, 1 - oldFill); clipping adds max(0, rawIncrement - (1 - oldFill)); maxKineticFillIncrement is the maximum rawIncrement
eventUpdate.attachmentRule: after all initial-boundary increments for a cycle are evaluated, attach every cell whose rawIncrement is greater than or equal to remaining room; steps 1 through 3 attach zero cells and step 4 atomically attaches indices [13, 31]
eventUpdate.topologyRule: after the event set attached = [13, 22, 31], independently re-enumerate boundary cells from the ordered neighbor table, require the exact frozen post-boundary roster, set attached fields to bitwise zero/fill one and every remaining active shell field to bitwise sigmaInfinity

ledgerIdentity.iceCellEquation: placedFillIceCells + saturationClippedFillIceCells = kineticDemandIceCells, accumulated once per initial boundary pixel and cycle
ledgerIdentity.holeFillRule: holeFillCount and holeFillDeficitIceCells remain exactly zero; hole fill is never folded into placed, clipped, or kinetic demand

referenceDerivation.eventProcedure: hold pre-event rates fixed, use deltaTime = cflFill / maxRate, advance exact per-boundary demand/placed/clipped fill, and stop at the first nonempty simultaneous attachment set
referenceDerivation.postEventProcedure: derive the attached/boundary transition from integer neighbors, construct the exact shell/zero post-state, and independently verify its fixed-point relaxation diagnostics
referenceDerivation.ledgerProcedure: accumulate placed, clipping, demand, vapor units, hole count, and hole deficit from raw cycle increments rather than a producer summary
